label: Adult cancer (non-skin)

source.name: CDC PLACES, measure CANCER
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

notes: Modeled estimates from a national survey (BRFSS), not counts of local diagnoses. CDC says the model cannot detect effects of local sources.
Uncertainty is half the 95% confidence interval.
Latest data year is 2023; later years have no data.
The survey question changed in 2022 (now includes melanoma). 2019–2021 and 2022–2023 are ranked separately and must not be read as one trend.
